snippet_primary: "Domestika Plus cannot be paid with cash or bank transfer. In Mexico, Colombia and Brazil, you can pay for your Domestika Plus subscription with a card (debit or credit) or digital wallets. Remember that Domestika Plus is a subscription and requires an associated payment method that enables automatic renewal."
